name: Contract values for CME equity index futures: point value and tick size (fees are not here)
how_checked: 2026-11-18, CME Group pages read through a web search index only: cmegroup.com refuses automated reading (HTTP 403 under its Data Terms of Use). tick_value is point_value times tick_size.

contracts.name: E-mini Nasdaq-100
contracts.note: CME: $20 x the Nasdaq-100 index, minimum tick 0.25 index points = $5.00.

contracts.name: Micro E-mini Nasdaq-100
contracts.note: CME rulebook chapter 361: each futures contract is valued at $2.00 times the Nasdaq-100 index; minimum tick 0.25 index points = $0.50.

contracts.name: E-mini S&P 500
contracts.note: CME: $50 x the S&P 500 index; a quarter point move is worth $12.50 (outright; calendar spreads trade in smaller ticks).

contracts.name: Micro E-mini S&P 500
contracts.note: CME: $5 x the S&P 500 index, minimum tick 0.25 index points = $1.25.
